class.name: rviz_plugins/Geofence
class.description: Visualizes a geofence from geometry_msgs::PolygonStamped as vertical edge bands with a vertical fade. Edges are rendered as thin 3D rectangles with a configurable height, thickness, and alpha gradient.

class.name: rviz_plugins/PlanRoute
class.description: Configures and monitors the Lanelet2 route planning action client. Supports saved waypoint routes, random destinations, and destinations selected with the Goal Pose tool.
